title: The Region 6 Wrap: Caribbean Passport Deadline, AfroTech, Brazil's Real | Across the Water, Ep. 12
lede: The week of Nov 9 in the business of the African diaspora: five Eastern Caribbean states face the EU's Nov 12 deadline on citizenship by investment, AfroTech reports 35,000 attendees in Houston, the UK opens £600,000 in Windrush claim-support grants, and Brazil's real hits a 12-month low. Plus Caribbean currencies and the latest Black unemployment rate.
keyPoints: Five Eastern Caribbean states were due to answer the EU by Nov 12 on closing citizenship-by-investment programmes by June 1, 2028; Antigua proposed a 2030 exit with EU support and Saint Lucia says it has replied (Caribbean National Weekly, Rio Times).
Saint Lucia's PM says its programme raised about EC$65M (≈US$24M) last year (Caribbean National Weekly).
AfroTech 2026 in Houston drew 35,000 attendees citywide, organisers say (Blavity via PR Newswire).
The Home Office opened £600,000 in 2027–28 grants for Windrush compensation claim support; applications close Dec 4 (Home Office).
The dollar closed at 5.64 reais on Nov 12, a 12-month high; US Black unemployment was 6.6% in October (Rio Times, BLS).
